text: dsh-skill-scan 是一个接入 DSH 工具与技能系统的技能和插件包静态扫描插件。它通过 DSH 的 skill_scan 工具读取用户指定的本地目录，检查文本及配置文件中的规则模式，并把命中项整理成 Markdown 或 JSON 报告。命令行入口也能扫描目录，提供文本或 JSON 输出和状态码。适合在安装或分享技能包前快速查看扫描结果；使用需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-skill-scan adds a DSH tool for static scans of local skill and plugin bundles. Give skill_scan a directory path to receive a Markdown or JSON report of matched rules; its CLI offers the same formats and an exit status. It requires Node.js 20 or later and no API key or external service.
我想先对一个本地技能目录做静态扫描并看报告。
有没有工具能把插件包的规则命中整理成 JSON？
想从命令行检查一个技能包并根据结果状态码处理。
dsh-skill-scan 的功能「DSH 目录扫描」：通过 skill_scan 工具对给定的本地目录进行静态扫描，并返回报告文本、命中数量、判定和分数。调用时提供 path，可选 markdown 或 json 格式。
dsh-skill-scan 的功能「命令行扫描」：运行 CLI 并传入目录路径，可选 --json 输出 JSON 报告；默认输出 Markdown，并以进程状态码表示扫描结果或输入错误。

dsh-skill-scan README · Skill Scan for DSH：> A static first pass for third-party skills and plugin bundles. Inspired by NVIDIA SkillSpector's
> supply-chain idea, implemented as a small DSH tool plus a CLI. It does not execute the bundle.

dsh-skill-scan README · What it finds：- Instruction override / exfiltration language
- `curl ... | sh` remote shell
- destructive root/home delete
- credential paths (`.ssh/id_rsa`, `.aws/credentials`)
- `eval` / `new Function`
- long encoded payloads
- hidden Unicode (bidi/zero-width)
- package lifecycle scripts
- `!!js` in Cordis patches

dsh-skill-scan README · CLI：```bash
node bin/dsh-skill-scan.mjs /path/to/bundle
node bin/dsh-skill-scan.mjs /path/to/bundle --json
```

Exit `1` on a `BLOCK`, `0` on `PASS`/`WARN`, `2` on invalid input.

dsh-skill-scan README · DSH plugin：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /home/lrf/dsh/products/dsh-skill-scan
```

Then ask: “Use skill_scan on this bundle.” The tool is read-only.

dsh-skill-scan README · What a result means：`PASS` means **no finding under these heuristics**. It is not proof of safety. `BLOCK` means a high
finding needs an explanation before installation. Read the exact file and line; the scanner is not a
sandbox, AST taint engine, OSV lookup, or runtime monitor.

False positives are possible: a security document may quote an attack, and a legitimate package may
use a lifecycle script. Context matters.

dsh-skill-scan README · Tests：```bash
npm test
```

The fixtures include a deliberately unsafe bundle; the test only reads it as text and never executes it.

dsh-skill-scan README · Provenance：Inspired by [NVIDIA SkillSpector](https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector); no source code copied.
